Article Name: Optimisation Investigation and Bond-Slip Behaviour of High Strength PVA-Engineered Geopolymer Composite (EGC) Cured in Ambient Temperatures
Author: Vishal Avinash Ramesh, Ehsan Nikbakht Jarghouyeh, Ahmed Saleh Alraeeini, Amin Al-Fakih
Curing method: ambient temperature curing, no heat curing (humidity / sealing not stated)
Source table/page: Table 5 (mix), Table 2 (PVA), Sec 2.1/3.4 (ambient curing), Table 12 (fc, mix 4)
Conversions / notes: Mix 4 (20 % silica fume replacement), the only mix with full proportions (Table 5, kg/m3). Binder B = FA 880 + GGBS 220 + SF 176 = 1276 kg/m3 (silica fume counted in binder; its 176 = 20 % of FA mass). Sodium silicate solution 283 kg/m3 -> WG/B (modulus and solids not stated). NaOH solution 112 kg/m3 -> 10 M NaOH solution = 30.03 wt% NaOH (SG 1.3321); OxyChem Caustic Soda Handbook, Table 1 (p. 30), 60 °F; molarity = (g NaOH/L)/40.00, linear interpolation; paper also says 400 g NaOH per litre (= 10 M). NaOH/B = solids, solution water added to W/B (88 kg/m3 free water + solution water). SP 17.6 kg/m3 (text: 2 % of FA). PVA 26 kg/m3 / 1300 = 2.0 vol% (text: 2 vol%). Curing only described as ambient temperature (no temperature value). No tensile strain reported.
